instagram.caption:
A plain steel box quietly made almost everything you own cheaper 📦

In 1956, trucking entrepreneur Malcom McLean's ship Ideal X carried 58 containers from Newark to Houston. Loading loose cargo by hand cost about $5.83 a ton; loading containers cost around 16 cents. Standard boxes that move from ship to train to truck unopened rewired global trade.
